headline: Women leaders discuss modernizing traditional businesses at Business Today MPW Awards 2026
hook: Legacy firms adapt to evolving consumer markets
summary: Business Today's 23rd Most Powerful Women in Business Awards 2026 featured a panel discussion titled 'Tradition Meets Tomorrow'. Leaders including Rishma Kaur of Berger Paints India, Shalini Bhupal of Taj GVK Hotels & Resorts, and Avantika Saraogi of Balrampur Chini Mills participated. The panel explored how established companies across paints, hospitality, and sugar industries balance legacy preservation with digital innovation and changing consumer demands. Indian retail investors can observe these strategic shifts as indicators of long-term adaptability in legacy portfolios.
why_it_matters: Insights on how legacy firms plan future growth strategies

headline: Asian Paints, Berger, and Birla Opus to raise prices by 4%
hook: Rising crude costs trigger paint price hikes
summary: Asian Paints, Berger Paints, and Grasim's Birla Opus are set to increase product prices by 3-4% ahead of the Diwali festive season. The move follows a surge in crude oil prices, which have crossed the $100 per barrel mark, inflating raw material costs. This is the second price hike implemented by these major paint manufacturers this year. The increase aims to protect margins as input costs remain elevated.
why_it_matters: Higher home renovation costs for consumers during the festive season.
winners_losers: Paint manufacturers gain / Home renovators hurt

headline: Asian Paints, Kansai Nerolac, and Berger Paints slump up to 27% YTD amid subdued demand
hook: Paint giants slide up to 27% YTD
summary: Asian Paints, Kansai Nerolac, and Berger Paints have seen year-to-date stock declines of up to 27 percent due to subdued demand and competitive pressures. Elara Securities expects a recovery with 12-13 percent revenue growth ahead, though Q2 FY27 demand remains weak. Indian retail investors tracking consumer discretionary stocks should note the pressure on margins and valuations in the sector.
whats_next: Q2 FY27 earnings announcements for paint companies
why_it_matters: Paint stock valuations face pressure ahead of festive demand.
